title: Full Stack Foundations for Teens | Saylani Mass IT Training
text: Course: Full Stack Foundations for Teens. Category: Development. Duration: 2 months. Description: A fun, beginner-friendly course introducing kids to coding with Python and JavaScript through hands-on activities, mini projects, and interactive games. This course is offered free of cost by Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT), an initiative of Saylani Welfare International Trust. Admission is via the online registration form at https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll, selecting this course and a preferred campus/city. (Source: SMIT official AI data feed, saylanimit.com/llms-full.txt)
